programs.programName: AHCCCS (Arizona Long Term Care System - ALTCS)

verified.notes: ALTCS is an AHCCCS Medicaid long-term care program; for the senior pathway, the age threshold is 65+. The retrieved official source clearly supports the $2,000 individual resource limit and ALTCS toll-free contact number, but it did not provide a clearly retrievable couple asset limit on the same page.
